name: turkish
title: Turkish
description: Turkish text tools: put the Turkish letters back into text typed without them (Turkce yazilmis → Türkçe yazılmış), take them out again, and change case the Turkish way, where i and ı are two letters. Works on what you type or on the selection, pasting the result back over it.
author: pal

settings.label: Primary action
settings.description: What Enter does on a row; the other is cmd+Enter, and cmd+c always copies.

options.title: Paste into the app in front

store.tagline: Restore Turkish letters (Turkce → Türkçe) and change case correctly
features: Deasciify: letters restored from context (sik → sık, kus → kuş, acik → açık), using the Emacs turkish-mode table
Asciify: the reverse, for forms that take no Turkish letters
UPPERCASE, lowercase and Title Case the Turkish way (i ↔ İ, ı ↔ I); a suffix after an apostrophe stays down (İstanbul'da)
Select text in any app and open the list: `enter` pastes the result over the selection
`cmd+c` copies, `cmd+t` sends the result to Translate; each row says how many letters it changed
`pal://turkish/deasciify?text=…` and the other conversions for scripts and hotkeys

screenshots.caption: Opened over a selected sentence: its Turkish letters back, the reverse and the three cases; Enter replaces the selection
cmd+i shows the result over the source, what changed and where the text came from
Typed Turkish: the cases keep i and ı apart (İSTANBUL, ILIK) and a suffix after an apostrophe stays down
Paste, copy, hand the row to Translate, or copy the source text
